name: io.github.josealvaradoa/whoop-personal-mcp
title: WHOOP Personal MCP
description: Single-user, self-hosted Streamable HTTP server for read-only WHOOP wellness data; native MCP 2026-07-28 with a stateless 2025-era fallback.

environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID for your personal WHOOP Developer Platform app.

environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret for your personal WHOOP Developer Platform app.

environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_REDIRECT_URI
environmentVariables.description: Exact callback URI registered in WHOOP, normally http://localhost:3000/auth/whoop/callback for a local package run.

environmentVariables.name: ENCRYPTION_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: At least 32 characters; derives the key that encrypts WHOOP tokens at rest.

environmentVariables.name: ACCESS_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: At least 12 characters; confirms browser consent and WHOOP account linking.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional long-lived token for clients that use a static Authorization header.

environmentVariables.name: BIND_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Listening interface. Defaults to 127.0.0.1; set 0.0.0.0 only inside a protected container or remote host.

environmentVariables.name: PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Stable public origin used as the MCP OAuth issuer and canonical /mcp resource.

environmentVariables.name: ALLOWED_REDIRECT_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated exact HTTPS callback hostnames trusted for remote CIMD or DCR clients; loopback is allowed automatically.

environmentVariables.name: DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory containing the persistent SQLite database.
